title: pm-dispatch: the relay header gives a stale footer reason, and the PR-body door line does not say to send no footer
body:
domain:skills#3 · huangyiirene · session_01J8VVAj7CvjkGXvgXzd6RZ7

Filing gate: out-of-scope findings S1 and S3 of the contract review of PR #31058 (card #31050). Both fall outside that PR's claimed lines. ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the grade and the lane.
class: c · reach: every seat that rewrites a pull request body, and every reader of the relay's header.

## What is left

1. **`scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs` header L454–456 gives a stale reason.** It says "an edit of a pull's body gets the bare footer block appended after the trailer (`platform-readings.md`, the edit side), so send no footer of your own". The relay's own read-back shows otherwise: every `issue_patch` of a PR body in this lane on 2026-11-06 read back "N sent, N stored — identical". Examples are PR #29225 at 6785 B and PR #31049 at 8149 B. Both stored bodies end at the signed trailer with no footer. PR #31058 adds that relay reading to `platform-readings.md`. The advice "send no footer" still holds; only the stated reason should change to match.
2. **The no-footer rule has no home on the PR-body door line.** `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-post-protocol.md` L31 (the PR-body line PR #31049 added) names the trailer and the door, but not 「不送页脚」. Every rewrite now points to that line (`os-dev.md` L66, `platform-readings.md` L290, `rest-channel.md` L17), so L31 should carry it. L31 is at the 120 B cap, and every spelling measured was 127–133 B. It needs a same-file restatement deletion to make room for a second line, or a ceiling ruling. The risk is low: the tool refuses a body whose last non-empty line is not the trailer, and the relay appends nothing.

**Level:** internal agent tooling (`.claude/**` and a `scripts/pm/**` comment), `skip-changeset`, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.

Related: #31050, PR #31058, PR #31049, #29285.
